title: CDR for Engineers Australia Migration Assessment
description: Prepare a CDR for the Engineers Australia skills assessment used in temporary work and permanent residency visa applications.

data.sub: Engineers Australia skills assessment for work visas and permanent residency.

data.heading: Who Needs It
paragraphs: Engineers Australia uses the CDR to assess engineers whose overseas qualification is not covered by an international accord.
A positive skills assessment is then used in a temporary work or permanent residency visa application.

items.title: Check
items.text: Confirm your occupation and qualification route.

items.title: Lodge
items.text: Submit it to Engineers Australia yourself.

items.title: Visa
items.text: Use the outcome in your visa application.

items.q: Is a CDR the same as a visa application?
items.a: No. The CDR supports a skills assessment by Engineers Australia. A visa application is a separate process lodged with the Department of Home Affairs.

items.q: Do I need a CDR if my degree is from an accord country?
items.a: Often not, because accord qualifications are usually assessed on the qualification itself. Check the current Engineers Australia requirements for your degree.

items.q: Can you advise on my visa?
items.a: We offer visa consultation and migration guides. For formal visa advice, consult a registered migration agent.
